using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenMigrateSlotsDriverInlineFails()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new MigrateSessionForTest(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.SetupMigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync(false);
            migrateSession.SetupTryRecoverFromFailureAsync(true);

            // Act
            await migrateSession.InvokeBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("MigrateSlotsDriver failed")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            Assert.Equal(MigrateState.FAIL, migrateSession.Status);
        }

        // Helper subclass to expose private method and allow setup
        private class MigrateSessionForTest : MigrateSession
        {
            private bool _migrateSlotsDriverInlineResult;
            private bool _tryRecoverFromFailureResult;

            public MigrateSessionForTest(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
                // Setup other required fields or mocks as needed
            }

            public void SetupMigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync(bool result)
            {
                _migrateSlotsDriverInlineResult = result;
            }

            public void SetupTryRecoverFromFailureAsync(bool result)
            {
                _tryRecoverFromFailureResult = result;
            }

            public async Task InvokeBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync()
            {
                await BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();
            }

            // Override the method to simulate failure or success
            protected override Task<bool> MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_migrateSlotsDriverInlineResult);
            }

            protected override Task<bool> TryRecoverFromFailureAsync()
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_tryRecoverFromFailureResult);
            }
        }
    }
}
